title: LandlordGuard Installment Fee Amount
content:
**Tariff rule.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the installment fee is the fee basis for the installment plus the fee adjustment, never below 0.00, rounded half-up to the cent once on the final figure. The standard fee basis is the tier's installment service charge, and the standard fee adjustment is zero.

## Reading the rule

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Fee basis | the tier's installment service charge |
| Fee adjustment | zero |
| Floor | the fee is never below 0.00 |
| Rounding | once, half-up to the cent, on the fee itself |

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier charges)

| Tier's installment service charge taken as | Fee basis | Fee adjustment | Installment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6.00 USD | 6.00 | 0.00 | 6.00 USD |
| 5.00 USD | 5.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 USD |
| 4.00 USD | 4.00 | 0.00 | 4.00 USD |

The same fee is charged for each installment that carries one; it is posted against that installment's term and position.
